'''{{PAGENAME}}''' are [[:Category:Tools|Tool]] items used to spread [[Beckon]] infestation.

== ''Obtainment'' ==
Placing a [[Strange Bone]], [[Hardened Bone Handle]], or [[Yelloweye Bone]] in the crafting table.

== ''Usage'' ==
Right-clicking infestable blocks will spread [[Beckon]] infestation in the area, turning blocks into their infested variants. Right-clicking a [[Thornshade#Thornshade Berry Bush|Thornshade Berry Bush]] will cause it to either progress to the next stage or regrow its [[Thornshade#Thornshade Berry|berries]]. It can also speed up the growth of Infected Saplings.

Its useful to turn ores into their [[Pestilential Ore|Pestilential variant]], or turn Pestilential ores into their Twisted Spinal Signal variant. It can also be a quite unconventional source of [[Residue Block]] and by extension [[Residue Bloomings]].
